hero.lead: Advanced Information Systems Engineering student at the National University of Costa Rica. I build web applications and management systems with Laravel and Spring Boot, and I teach robotics to high school students.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I study Information Systems Engineering at the National University of Costa Rica. I'm mostly drawn to the backend: modeling data, designing an application's architecture, and writing code someone else can maintain.

I also teach. Since 2023 I have run educational robotics workshops for high school students, and in 2024 I supported classmates in the robotic process automation course with UiPath. Explaining a topic in plain words forces me to understand it well.
I'm looking for my first professional role as a backend developer, on a team where I can learn and contribute from day one.

bullets: Built a management system for a veterinary clinic with Laravel, together with the team.
Took part in requirements analysis, architecture design, and data modeling.
Guided the team through adopting Scrum: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
Design and teach educational robotics workshops for high school students.
Build robots and adapt teaching material to different levels.
Support teams as they test, fail, and improve their prototypes.
Supported classmates in the robotic process automation course with UiPath.
Answered questions and explained course concepts.
Reviewed their exercises and the progress of their automations.

items.title: Veterinary management system
items.subtitle: Capstone project
items.description: Platform for a veterinary clinic: appointment scheduling, medical history, and a catalog of products and services. Laravel and MySQL with an MVC architecture.
highlights: Relational model for appointments, services, and the product catalog
Separate service layer to make testing easier

items.title: REST API with Spring Boot
items.subtitle: Java backend course
items.description: REST service with CRUD operations, a layered architecture (controller, service, and repository), and data validation.
highlights: Bean Validation and global error handling
Postman collection to test every endpoint

items.notes: Software architecture, data modeling, and project management.
Programming fundamentals, software design, databases, and web development.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: I'm looking for my first backend developer role and I'm open to collaborative projects. Email me or send a WhatsApp message; I usually reply within a day.
